activity.notes: James VI of Scotland also became monarch of the separate Kingdom of Ireland in 1603 as James I and remained king until 1625. ATLAS records the Irish crown separately because Ireland remained a distinct kingdom under the same monarch rather than being the same Polity as England or Scotland.

sources.title: James I — Kingdom of Ireland reign — History of Parliament
sources.citation_text: The History of Parliament peerage database identifies James I as monarch of the Kingdom of Ireland from 24 March 1603 until 27 March 1625.
